description: Rename a tag on every monitor and heartbeat that carries it; an item that already has the new name keeps one copy. Use it to fix a naming scheme across the organization; to change the tags of chosen monitors only use bulk_update_monitor_tags, and to drop a tag use delete_tag. Requires a key with the write scope. A tag nothing carries is not an error (both counts are 0). Returns from, to, monitors_updated and heartbeats_updated. Example: {"from": "prod", "to": "env:prod"}

from.description: The existing tag, as list_tags shows it.

to.description: The new name. Each tag is trimmed, lowercased and deduplicated on write, at most 50 characters of a-z, 0-9 and : _ . / -, starting with a letter or digit. Reuse names from list_tags rather than inventing near-duplicates.

name: rename_tag
title: Rename a tag everywhere
